name: background
description: Run a request as a background task and deliver the answer to the bell when it's done: 'research the best laptops under 200k in the background', 'in the background: summarize my unread email', 'compare these phones and let me know when it's done'. Approvals still ask (in the bell).
route: in the background, let me know when it's done, notify me when finished, work on this in the background
